body.name: primitive edge signal ratios
body.construction: For an edge \(u\to v\) that is a weak component, set \(p_u(x)=p_{N_u}(x-f_u)\), \(p_v(y)=\int p_u(x)p_{N_v}(y-f_v(x))\,dx\), and \(m_{uv}(y)=\int xp_u(x)p_{N_v}(y-f_v(x))\,dx/p_v(y)\). Define \(\rho^{\to}_{uv}=\operatorname{Var}_{p_u}(f_v(X_u))/[\operatorname{Var}_{p_u}(f_v(X_u))+\operatorname{Var}(N_v)]\) and \(\rho^{\leftarrow}_{uv}=\operatorname{Var}_{p_v}(m_{uv}(V_v))/\operatorname{Var}_{p_u}(X_u)\).
